summary: Indian stocks look set for a weak start after a sharp tech-led sell-off on Wall Street spread to Asia, though steady foreign buying offers some cushion.

detail.tone: A forward-looking read before Tuesday's open, weaker than last night's note: the US sell-off deepened into the close and Asian markets opened lower.
